The answer key was checked against Texas and NRC radiography rules (25 TAC §289.255, 10 CFR Part 34) and standard radiography data. Answers marked Medium depend on a small figure or a judgment call. Three chart and meter questions could not be read from the source video and are shown for practice but not scored. Words in [brackets] were unreadable in the source video and were filled in from context. Your exam will give you its own data sheet, so use its values.
